pages.text: Health 28, Armor 2, Attack 4, Speed 0.34.$(br)The great arthropods of the Second Round world, and they come in plenty of colours - if you have the leisure, you could dress one up.

It fights the way Goety's spider servants do: it climbs walls, runs over webs unhindered and headbutts anything outside its faction. In the Second Round world a $(l)Spider Nest$() that would have produced ordinary spider servants instead produces them.$(br)

common spider servant produces one of these instead, while the skeleton, ice, cave and weaver variants keep their own slots. Now and then one even carries a Second Round skeleton rider.$(br)In the Second Round world a $(l:crafts/artifice/spider_nest)Spider Nest$() produces these rather than ordinary spiders; raise one nest and the colony is yours.
